Product description

HMYC Original Car Upgrade Mazda Wireless Carplay Box

The adapter kit is suitable for Mazda Connect and MZD Connect systems. Upgrade your car to a smart car and get Wireless Carplay and Android Auto functions. Enjoy music while driving, receive and send information, support Sirt and Google Assistant. Realize smart and safe driving.

You will enjoy Six Benefits while you having this Mazda Carplay Kit!

  • Support Wireless Apple Carplay
  • Support Wired Android Auto(in wired mode)
  • Support Voice Control and Hand-free Calling
  • Support Original Car Knob Control
  • Support Steering Wheel Operation

NEWEST UPGRADED WIRELESS CARPLAY VERSION

Wireless connection brings you more benefits.

  • No need for wired connections anymore,it can quickly convert wired CarPlay to wireless CarPlay
  • After firstly connected, the box automatically start and quickly connect to your iPhone when the car engine starts. Even if your iPhone is in your pocket or backpack, the built-in 5Ghz WIFI module will make your CD host to quickly identify your phone.

Warm Tips:

  • So far the box only supports wireless Carplay function, not supporting Wirelsss Android Auto.
  • The Bluetooth name is "Carplaybox_xxxx", the last four digits of the Bluetooth name of each box are different.
  • Please make sure that your iPhone's Bluetooth and WIFI are on.
  • Please turn off the Bluetooth function of the original car
  • If you need to use Wired CarPlay, please switch to wired mode.
  • Wireless connection normally takes 20–35 seconds

Why choose HMYC New P3 Upgraded Mazda Carplay HUB?

  • Supporting Wireless Apple Carplay
  • Faster connection speed with your iPhone.
  • Faster charging your devices while connecting your smart phones to the Hub’s USB port. Especially when you drive long distances, you will realize how important it is.
  • When you don't want to use the wireless function, you can switch to wired mode, supporting wired CarPlay and wired Android Auto in wired mode.


Support original car functions

Support your original car knob control and your original steering wheel button control, keep your drive more safety. Stay connected to your world while keeping your eyes focused on the road with our smartphone screen mirroring kit.


Support All Apps from Carplay/Android Auto

Supports IOS system and Android system, and SIRI and Google Assistant voice control can be perfectly adapted, which helps you focus on the road and enjoy along the way while getting directions, making calls, sending and receiving messages.


Package list

1 X Mazda HUB Unit

1 X USB Cable(Gray/Blue-Black)

1 X USB Cable(Gray/Blue-Brown)

1 X Sponge Tape (L=3m)

10 X Tie Wrap(L=200mm)

1 X Product Manuals

Perfect Compatibility

This carplay Adapter is suitable for Mazda Connect system, such as ：

Fits Mazda 2 2016-2019;

Fits Mazda 3 2014-2018;

Fits Mazda 6 2016-2020;

MX-5 2016-2020;

CX- 3 2016- 2019;

CX-5 2015-2020;

CX-9 2016-2020;

FIAT 124 2017- 2021.

And more

Warm Tips：

1.The software version of your car firmware system must be V70.00.21 or later

2.How to check your car firmware version?

Click the button “Setting”-“System”-“About”- “Version Information”- “OS Version”

3.How to upgrade your car firmware system?

Please refer to the upgrade method in the manual book.

<1>To prevent noise , wrap the disconnected vehicle wiring harness connector with a piece of sponge tape( 100 x 30 mm).

<2>The diagram shows the case when there is a single vehicle wiring harness connector.

<3>If there are two vehicle wiring harness connectors , carry out the same procedure for both connectors.

Legal disclaimer: This Carplay Retrofit kit does not include any SD map cards or any software data. We do not provide any products or software services other than those listed in the original package.

    So far so good

    Reviewed in the United States on October 4, 2024

    I installed this in a 2017 Mazda CX-5 Touring. Everything came as described but it only included instructions on how to connect your phone to the unit after installation along with an image of which ends of the wires connect to the unit and the head unit. After looking at a few videos on YouTube I found one that gave simple instructions on how removing the old unit, run the wires under the console without removing everything and an easy way to access the head unit to plug it in. Overall it took maybe 30 minutes to install. So far the CarPlay is working great, the wireless connection takes a few seconds but after that it functions as it should. The touchscreen and command dials still work as well. I some reviews about losing the connection after a few months so we’ll see but so far so good.

    Wireless CarPlay Works Perfectly!

    Reviewed in the United States on July 4, 2023
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I'm so happy that this product exists! I've been wanting to get CarPlay in my 2014 Mazda 3 for years, but was too intimidated by the install (I'm not handy at all) and the dealership wanted too much money for it. Now, I'm glad I waited because this seems to be the only unit I've been able to find that comes with wireless CarPlay, and it works perfectly! The install wasn't as difficult as I was expecting. I just followed the installation video on YouTube by Greg F. Pettus and took my time.

    The only reason I gave this 4/5 stars and not 5/5 stars is that the USB port where your phone is supposed to go in for wired CarPlay does not charge my phone at all. However, the USB port below that one works for charging my phone, and since CarPlay is wireless on this model, it doesn't really make a huge difference assuming that bottom USB port never fails on me.

    I'm super happy that this wireless CarPlay model is available and works great. I'd definitely recommend.

    Great, when it works… Great customer service.

    Reviewed in the United States on August 11, 2023
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I purchased the wireless version of the Retrofit Kit and opted for professional installation. The initial experience was positive - it connected seamlessly and provided the convenience of a wire-free environment.

    However, I began to encounter issues by the third use. Suddenly, CarPlay wouldn’t load. Regardless of the numerous troubleshooting steps I took - from wired connections to device removal and reconnection, and even resetting my phone’s paired devices - the kit displayed inconsistent functionality. At times, it would just begin to work again after a few hours, leaving me puzzled about its erratic behavior. It's disheartening because when it works, it's fantastic. Yet, due to these reliability concerns, I initially rated this product 2 stars.

    Update:

    I wanted to provide an update regarding my experience with the seller. After my initial review, the seller promptly reached out to me offering troubleshooting advice, a replacement, or a solution to ensure customer satisfaction. It’s not often you come across such proactive and considerate customer service. Their dedication to addressing customer concerns has genuinely impressed me. Because of their outstanding customer service, I’ve decided to revise my rating to 5 stars. While the product had its hiccups, the company's responsiveness and commitment to their customers is exemplary. 5 stars.

    When you haven’t started the car in a while, it does take a few seconds for the CarPlay to connect but nothing crazy. Super simple to install. I’d say the hardest part is removing the old usb hub. What I found to work though was removing the face plate with a couple picks in the sd card opening. I was then able to just work the hub out with a pair of pliers. Probably sounds complicated for some clips, but it worked out great. Other than that, smooth sailing. You’ll have some extra cord, I just wrapped it up with a zip tie and secured it to some plastic behind the kickplate on the passenger side floor. Everything works great with the control knob, touchscreen, and voice commands. All fitments are nice and tight as well. Highly recommend.

    Tech Up Your Ride: Mazda's Wireless Carplay Kit Brings Futuristic Fun

    Reviewed in the United States on January 6, 2024
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Alright, let's talk about the Mazda Wireless Carplay Retrofit Kit. This little gadget is like a magical portal that transforms your Mazda's entertainment system into a tech wizard's dream. It's the TK78-66-9U0C model, and it's specifically designed to fit into the MZD Connect System of various Mazda models ranging from 2014 to 2021, including the Mazda 2, 3, 6, CX3, CX5, CX9, and MX5. Unfortunately for Android Auto fans, this kit only supports Wireless Carplay, so it's more of an Apple orchard than a Google play park​​.

    Before you dive into installation, there's a little catch: your Mazda's firmware needs to be updated to at least version 70.00.21; otherwise, your shiny new toy might just sit there, unrecognized and lonely. So ensure your Mazda's brain is up-to-date, or you'll be stuck in last year's tech land​​.

    Now, if you're the adventurous DIY type, there are a few ways to retrofit wireless Carplay into your Mazda. It's like choosing your own adventure - either you've already got a factory-installed setup that just needs a little tweaking, or you go for the wireless Carplay adapter route. It's all about what fits your situation, your budget, and your Mazda model​​.

    And let's talk about this particular kit from the Amazon cosmos. It's the Type-C Mazda Wireless Apple CarPlay Retrofit Kit, and it's like the Swiss Army knife of Carplay kits. It's compatible with a wide range of Mazda models and years, and it's got all the bells and whistles of a modern tech gadget, minus support for Android Auto. So, if you're an iPhone wielder, this is your golden ticket to wireless Carplay bliss​​.

    TL;DR: The Mazda Wireless Carplay Retrofit Kit is like a fairy godmother for your Mazda, turning it into a Carplay wonderland. Just make sure your Mazda's brain is updated, choose your retrofitting adventure, and voilà, you're in the modern age of car entertainment.

    Wireless Carplay in Mazda6 2019 funktioniert!

    Reviewed in Germany on August 1, 2023
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    UPDATE: Hat zweieinhalb Jahre meist sehr gut funktioniert. Immer mal wieder gab es bei iOS Updates Probleme, aber diese hat Apple dann immer behoben. Seit iOS 26 (Beta), iOS 26.01 sowie aktuell iOS 26.1 RC verbindet sich mein iPhone 15 PRO Max nicht mehr mit dem Gerät. Es ist somit aktuell nicht mehr zu verwenden. Ich hoffe immer noch auf ein Update, das das Problem löst.

    Original Rezension:

    Ich hatte zunächst vor, die kabelgebundene original Carplay-Integration von Mazda installieren zu lassen. Dann habe ich dieses Gerät entdeckt. Meine Idee war: Wenn die wireless Integration nicht funktioniert, kann ich hier einfach auf wired umschalten. Ich muss dazu sagen, dass mir mein Mazda-Händler das Gerät installiert hat. Kosten ca. 140 Euro. Ich bin mir aber sicher, dass ich es, mit den diversen Youtube Videos, auch alleine geschafft hätte. Der Händler hat mir dabei auch gleich die neueste Software Version für das Mazda Infotainment installiert, was alleine schon 30-40 Minuten dauert.

    Bei mir war die Box direkt nach der Installation nicht auswählbar. Das hat mir sehr viel Kopfzerbrechen gemacht, hat sich aber über Nacht „von alleine“ gelöst, da der Mazda da wohl den Strom komplett von der Box nimmt, was zu einem Neustart führt. Am nächsten Morgen hat alles funktioniert.

    Mein iPhone 12 ist schnell genug für Carplay, alles läuft geschmeidig. Die einzelnen Navi-Apps sind unterschiedlich gut in Carplay integriert. Ich habe früher immer TomTom go verwendet, das jedoch nicht ganz so gut integriert ist, wie Apple Karten, oder Google Maps. Aber ALLES ist besser, als die „here“-Karten des original Navis, dass sich ja nicht richtig mit dem iPhone Hotspot verbinden lässt und daher keine aktuellen Verkehrsinfos liefert.

    Ich hatte übrigens direkt, als das Gerät scheinbar nicht funktionierte, den Support des chinesischen Herstellers per WhatsApp kontaktiert, der sich direkt zu „Bürozeiten“ in China gemeldet hat. Ich nutze das Gerät jetzt seit zwei Wochen und kann nur Positives sagen. Eine Kleinigkeit, die auch in einem anderen Kommentar hier zu lesen ist. Von den beiden USB Anschlüssen lädt nur der das iPhone, der nicht das Smartphone Symbol hat. Ich vermute dieser Anschluss ist nur bei Carplay via Kabel aktiv. Man kann also nicht zwei iPhones gleichzeitig laden.

    Installation is not easy!

    Reviewed in Australia on July 25, 2026
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Be warned! It’s definitely not as easy as it sounds to install. You need to run cables through your car from your existing head unit, down behind your aircon, and depending on the location of your USB hub, even through the centre console to your armrest. I have a Mazda 3 2014 (BM SP25 GT) model. I bought this thinking it would be a simple swap of the usb hub and maybe the cables were just short and needed to be changed over. Looking at the instructions it seems like it’s just a swap and change cable. The instructions are almost useless when it comes to running the cables through your car. After doing lots of research and watching lots of videos, I learnt how to pull apart my car and do that swap.

    It’s not that hard to do but it took me about 2 hours all up. That’s not including watching at least an hours worth of videos on how to remove the car parts. Plus about another hour to update the firmware. The firmware topic was actually really annoying to arrange because you can’t simply download the firmware online (at least for my car in Australia). I had to join a Mazda forum and ask for support and wait for someone to send me the link to download the file. I waited 24 hours for a response.

    All up I’ve spent at least 4-5 hours to get his competed in my specific scenario.

    In the end the product does exactly what it says, the only issue would be the installation is not specific so they can’t provide a video for every make and model car.

    I’ve only tested it so far (1 day) and it’s working perfectly. I purchased the wireless CarPlay model and that works as well as the wired CarPlay.

    I will update my review if I have any issues like some people have mentioned about wireless dropping out.

About this Item

  • 【NEWEST UPGRADED WIRELESS CARPLAY】Apple CarPlay is powerful and friendly driving assistance system. This Mazda Carplay hub upgraded your car to more Smarter and safer while driving. That allows you to access map navigation, phone contacts, email, notifications, music and get help from intelligent Siri voice assistant.
  • 【Why choose our Mazda Carplay Kit】1. Wireless connection, no need data cable. 2. Faster and more stable connection speed with your iPhone. 3. Faster charging your devices while connecting your smart phones to the Hub’s UBS port. When you use the Mazda Carplay for a long time, you will realize how important it is. 4. We provide professional technical support services and 24-months warranty
  • 【Perfect Match with Mazda】Replaces Part Number: TK78-66-9U0C K1414 00008FZ34 . Compatible with Mazda Connect System, Such as CX-5 2013-2016; CX-9 2016-2020; CX-3 2014-2020; Mazda 2 2014-2020；Mazda 3 2013-2018；Mazda 6 2015-2020；MX-5 2015-2020. (Please feel free to ask if your car is compatible)
  • 【Keep Original Car Function Well】 This Smart Carplay adapter supports your original car knob controls and your original steering wheel button controls, allowing you to operate without leaving the steering wheel. Making your driving safer.
  • 【Warm Reminder】The version only supports wireless Carplay, not supporting wireless Android Auto. Please confirm the software version of your car firmware system must be V70.00.21 or later before installation, if not, please upgrade the firmware first. (The SD card needs to be removed before upgrading the firmware, and then inserted after the upgrade is complete, otherwise GPS or navigation will not work properly)
  • NOTE: In wireless mode, this model is only compatible with iPhone devices. It does not support wireless Android Auto or wired Android Auto. Only by switching the wireless version to wired mode (the switch is located at the SD card slot) can it support wired CarPlay and wired Android Auto. However, wireless and wired modes cannot operate simultaneously.

Product Description

CarPlay Android Auto Retrofit Kit Fits for Mazda 3 6 CX-5 CX-3 MX-5 Miata Replaces TK78-66-9U0C Function: Stay connected to your world while keeping your eyes focused on the road with our smartphone screen mirroring kit. This upgrade kit enhances the MAZDA CONNECT infotainment system with CarPlay allowing you to access your iPhone’s maps, playlists, contacts and compatible apps with your voice through Siri. Siri will also read incoming text messages and allow you to reply without taking your hands off the wheel. You can also navigate the features of CarPlay with the optimally positioned multifunction Commander control. For Android users, this upgrade also adds Android Auto functionality. Compatible with: CX-3 All models 2016 to 2019 CX-5 All models 2016 to 2017 CX-9 All models 2016 to 2020 Mazda3 4-Door All models 2014 to 2018 Mazda3 5-Door All models 2014 to 2018 Mazda6 All models 2016 to 2020 MX-5 Miata Club / Grand Touring 2016 to 2020 MX-5 Miata RF Sport 2018 to 2019 MX-5 Miata Sport 2018 to 2020 Important Notice: MAZDA CONNECT unit NOT include. Software update NOT included The firmware MUST BE UPDATED FIRST before beginning the installation. If an older version of the CMU software is being used, the CarPlay/Android Auto-compatible USB hub may not be recognized. The software must be v70.00.21 or later. If not be sure to update the software. Once the CMU has been attached to the CarPlay/Android Auto-compatible USB hub, the software cannot be updated. These work on Mazda models that have MAZDA CONNECT. If you do not have a Mazda connect unit in your Mazda these will not work. Remainer: This version only has the wireless carplay, no wireless Android Auto.
